cause_quote: The diff replaced `renderSidebarScope(this)` with `renderSessionListToolbar(this, ...)` immediately above the `hidden` check for `this.contextualSidebar`, leaving the Sessions toolbar visible when Systems replaced the session list.
user_saw: Systems showed the Sessions owner picker, filter, and new-session controls above its device list, and clicking the agent avatar left the user on Systems.
summary: The fix gives Systems a header with its own title and a collapse control, and lets the agent avatar return to the last session.
reasoning: I classified the header defect named in the fix title and checked that Systems already had a working device list before #168997. In the parent, the rail rendered a scope control that returned nothing for the default unfiltered view, and the added toolbar put Sessions controls above the device list. The avatar symptom came from the later rail redesign in #199824, which treated an expanded Systems sidebar as an open Sessions list.
